text: タマムシ　シティって　とても　きれいな　まち　なのね

structure.jp: タマムシ　シティって
とても　きれいな　まち

patterns.name: 〜って (topic)
patterns.span: タマムシ　シティって
patterns.explanation: って is a chatty way to bring up what you are about to comment on, like は. タマムシ　シティって = 'Celadon City, well...'

patterns.name: 〜のだ
patterns.explanation: なの after a thing gives a soft feeling of 'so that's how it is', and ね asks for agreement. まち　なのね = 'it's a town like that, isn't it'.
